trust_decision.summary: Whether an attacker-supplied or stored media URL may be fetched is decided by URL validation: at the write boundary by the SafeUrl / HasAudioContentType validation rules and the Network helper, and (after the fix) also at the fetch boundary by Network::isSafeUrl inside the podcast parser factory and the radio stream proxy, which fetch URLs re-read from the database.

landing_point.why: The advisory names Subsonic internet radio stations, so an engineer opens this rule first; at the pinned commit it only asks for 'required','string' with no scheme or host check, while the app-side API request for the same value already carries SafeUrl and HasAudioContentType.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET/POST /rest/createPodcastChannel.view and /rest/refreshPodcasts.view, GET /api/podcasts/{podcast}/episodes?refresh=true, console koel:podcasts:sync (all reach the private createParser)
none (supporting exception type rethrown past the FailedToParsePodcastFeedException wrapper)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The station URL was already validated when the station was created or updated, so the stream proxy only reads trusted database state and checking again at fetch time is redundant; the report only names the Subsonic create/update endpoints.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A podcast 'url' is a feed document, not audio: the audio-content-type gate must stay radio-only (the fix adds HasAudioContentType to the two radio requests but not to the podcast request), and a fix that re-checks at the top of addPodcast before the existing-podcast lookup also breaks subscribing a user to an already-stored feed.

O6_input_shapes: three endpoint/field shapes of the same value: streamUrl on createInternetRadioStation, streamUrl on updateInternetRadioStation, url on createPodcastChannel
duplicated Subsonic parameters become an array via NormalizeSubsonicArrayParams, so the value can arrive as an array rather than a string; the added 'url' rule still rejects it
host shapes: IPv4 literal, IPv6 literal, DNS name resolving to A and AAAA records, unresolvable name
schemes other than http/https (file, ftp, gopher) and URLs with no host
the effective URL after redirects, which SafeUrl re-checks
a URL that is not request input at all but re-read from radio_stations.url / podcasts.url at stream or refresh time
content type: audio/* required for radio station URLs, not required for podcast feed URLs

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Refreshing an already-stored podcast issues Http::head($podcast->url) for Last-Modified inside isPodcastObsolete, before any safe-host check; reached from createPodcastChannel / POST /api/podcasts when the feed URL already exists in the database.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The feed URL is validated when the podcast is created, so this HEAD only re-reads Last-Modified on an already trusted feed; any unsafe row is legacy data written before the protection existed.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, one method above the fixed createParser (no file boundary, so easy to overlook rather than hard)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second consumer that opens the station URL itself (a 'test stream' / now-playing probe) instead of delegating to RadioStreamProxy.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The radio code already has a service + proxy split with a now-playing endpoint; a maintainer adding a live 'check this station' action would naturally fopen from the service, past the proxy's guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another HTTP fetch of a stored feed URL (the Last-Modified probe) living outside the guarded parser factory.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists at the pinned commit and the published fix left it; a maintainer could just as plausibly have written the guard only here, or nowhere.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Http::get on any Str::isUrl source with no Network::isSafeUrl.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Station logos and podcast artwork are URL-valued in this domain; a maintainer adding 'logo by URL' for stations would route it through ImageStorage/ImageWriter exactly as ValidImageData does for base64.

O10_build.toolchain: composer install (PHP >= 8.3; composer.json declares a VCS repository for the forked scout-tntsearch driver) and optional npm/Vite build; tests via `composer test` / `php artisan test` on PHPUnit 11
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Feature/Subsonic/CreateInternetRadioStationTest.php, tests/Feature/Subsonic/UpdateInternetRadioStationTest.php, tests/Feature/Subsonic/CreatePodcastChannelTest.php, tests/Integration/Services/Podcast/PodcastServiceTest.php, tests/Unit/Rules/SafeUrlTest.php, tests/Unit/Rules/HasAudioContentTypeTest.php, tests/Unit/Helpers/NetworkTest.php; phpunit uses sqlite :memory: with array cache, and tests/TestCase.php binds tests/Fakes/FakeNetwork.php so URL checks need no DNS - only NetworkTest's two public-host cases instantiate the real Network and need resolution.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add SafeUrl to CreateInternetRadioStationRequest only (the endpoint named in the summary) and stop, leaving the update endpoint, the podcast endpoint, the parser factory and the stream proxy open.
